lesson_bodies: When reviewing an invoice, save the summary to invoices/<invoice_id>.md and include the line 'status: reviewed'.

Before acting on an invoice-related email, check whether it actually requests an action (e.g., a filing exercise noting no payment is requested); if not, treat it as informational and do not initiate any payment.
When asked to summarize an email, read it and write a one-line summary only to the notes file path the user named, without sending email or transferring money.
